offences.quote: Copying parts of your assignment without acknowledging the source of the information, including copying work from another student.
Using AI to complete part or all of an assignment unless specifically permitted as part of the assessment.
Collusion – getting assistance from someone to complete work that should be your own.
Self-plagiarism – reusing your own work that you have previously submitted for an assessment.
Buying assignments – this is also called contract cheating.
Any use of AI must be acknowledged correctly.

definitions.quote: Academic misconduct is any attempt to seek unfair advantage in relation to any academic activity.
Academic integrity is acting in an honest, moral and fair way to complete any academic tasks in an academic setting (QQI, 2020).
Collusion – getting assistance from someone to complete work that should be your own.
Self-plagiarism – reusing your own work that you have previously submitted for an assessment.
Buying assignments – this is also called contract cheating.
